name: Mock Cabbage Rolls
description: A casserole-style dish mimicking cabbage rolls, featuring a savory ground beef and rice mixture layered over shredded cabbage and topped with cheddar cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown hamburger with chopped onion, salt, pepper, mushrooms, seasoning salt, onion powder, and garlic salt in a skillet.
Add rice, tomatoes, and soup to the browned hamburger mixture; mix well.
Shred cabbage and place in the bottom of a large casserole dish.
Place the hamburger mixture on top of the cabbage layer.
Cover and bake in a preheated 350°F oven for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven, sprinkle cheddar cheese on top, cover, and return to oven for an additional 15 to 30 minutes, or until cabbage is cooked and cheese is melted.

keywords: mock cabbage rolls, casserole, cheesy cabbage

_similar.name: Cabbage Rolls
_similar.description: Traditional cabbage rolls filled with a savory mixture of ground pork, beef, and rice, simmered in tomato juice.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil the cabbage head for 10 minutes to soften the leaves. Drain and let cool.
Chop the onion and fry in lard for 10 minutes until softened.
Mix the cooked onion and lard with ground pork, ground beef, rice, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Peel off cabbage leaves and cut out the thick stem. Place about 1 tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center of each leaf, fold the sides, and roll into a neat package.
Line the bottom of a large pot with a layer of cabbage leaves to prevent burning.
Arrange the cabbage rolls seam-side down in the pot, layering them as needed.
Pour the tomato juice over the cabbage rolls, ensuring they are mostly covered.
Bring the tomato juice to a simmer, then reduce heat and let cook for the entire afternoon (approximately 3 hours).

_similar.keywords: cabbage rolls, stuffed cabbage, ground meat, comfort food

_similar.name: Cabbage Casserole
_similar.description: A creamy cabbage casserole with a crunchy bread crumb topping, baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook cabbage wedges until tender, then drain and cut into large pieces.
Make a white sauce with butter, flour, and milk. Season with salt, grated cheese, and Cheez Whiz.
Combine cooked cabbage with the white sauce mixture.
Top with crumbled buttered bread.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

_similar.keywords: cabbage casserole, creamy vegetable dish, comforting main course

_similar.name: Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A classic broccoli casserole with a cheesy, soup-based sauce and a crunchy topping.
recipeIngredient: Butter and bread crumbs or fried onions for topping

recipeInstructions.text: Partially cook broccoli and drain. Place in a large casserole dish.
Mix together Cheez Whiz, cream of chicken soup, mushroom soup, and cooked rice. Pour over broccoli.
Bake at 350°F for 30 to 40 minutes.
Top with butter and bread crumbs or a can of fried onions before serving.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, cheesy casserole, comforting main dish

_similar.name: Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli casserole topped with a cheesy bread crumb mixture, perfect for a comforting vegetable side.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together broccoli, celery, and mushroom soup. Place in a casserole dish.
Make the topping by combining grated cheese, melted margarine, sour cream, and bread crumbs.
Spread the topping over the casserole.
Bake at 325 °F to 350 °F for 25 to 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, cheesy, comforting vegetable side

_similar.name: T.V. Mix
_similar.description: A savory and crunchy snack mix featuring pretzels, Chex cereals, nuts, and a blend of seasonings, perfect for munching.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg pretzel sticks, broken into pieces

recipeInstructions.text: Melt the butter in a saucepan or microwave-safe bowl.
Add the salad oil, Worcestershire sauce, and celery salt to the melted butter and stir to combine.
In a large roasting pan, combine the broken pretzels, Chex cereals, and salted peanuts.
Pour the butter and oil mixture over the cereal and nut mixture, stirring until everything is evenly coated.
Bake in a preheated 200°F oven for 1½ hours, stirring occasionally.
Keep the roasting pan covered during baking, stirring every 15-20 minutes to ensure even toasting.

_similar.keywords: snack mix, Chex mix, party snack, savory snack
